changes: Saved analysis restores without constructing transaction editors; editors warm after main views and are reused until their data changes.
Quarterly share details are mounted once on expansion; visible share bars and accessible summaries remain immediately available.
Holdings calculations reuse quarter keys within each month, avoid reparsing saved numbers, and skip FIFO bookkeeping on unchanged days.

calculation_benchmark.measurement: Local CPython, 9 samples per case; not browser timing

additional_efficiency_pass.benchmark_method: Nine alternating before/after samples per case after warmup, using deterministic five-year fixtures with purchases, sales and a split. All historical quarter results were compared for exact equality.
additional_efficiency_pass.transaction_restore_test: Zero editor list assignments during saved-analysis restore; one during preparation or first Edit; retained across tab changes.
additional_efficiency_pass.browser_startup: Unmeasured in this environment; local calculations and component counts do not establish total browser startup time.

changes: One authenticated startup request returns shared account metadata and the current saved totals, returns and holdings.
Daily chart history follows in a deferred request after the visible saved values have a paint opportunity.
The first response seeds the metadata cache for retained pages; no extra account metadata round trip.
Editing and chart navigation wait for the complete history; current holdings filters work immediately.

changes: Store current summary, metrics and holdings with each saved analysis in the private analysis_overview column.
Reuse that summary on startup without decompressing or parsing the full history.
Upgrade older summary versions once on opening, with fingerprint and timestamp checks against concurrent edits or refreshes.
Apply current account sector choices to the small saved snapshot.
Retain visible holdings rows and reuse the server-computed latest quarter when full history arrives.

Record values_request_during_page_build and values_wait_after_page_build in the browser startup report.
